applies_why: The judge text does not count any cited verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it calls the matter underdetermined and says it was answered.
quote: answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge does not count the verses toward a broken link and expressly treats the issue as answered, not counting them obeys K-G4.
